how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-sort:invasion-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:9265:obj:0: Collect three Dim Necrotic Stones from the Scourge outside the ⟦E1⟧ and investigate the glowing runic circles near their encampment.
rows.quest:9265:details:0: The Lich King has sent his ⟦E2⟧ upon our very doorstep; we cannot remain idle! Surely you will step up to defend the ⟦E1⟧ from these accursed invaders? ⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧There are strange runic circles outside, glowing with the same energy that surrounds the ⟦E2⟧ and the Necropolis above. They have significance, I'm certain, and I want you to find out what. Thin the numbers of those aberrations while you're at it; bring me proof of their death along with your results, and I will reward you. Go!
rows.quest:9265:progress:0: Have you investigated the invasion yet? There's no time for dawdling!
rows.quest:9265:completion:0: Hmm. From what you've told me, the voices within the circles... they must be used for communication of some kind. I shudder to think what unnatural minds are contacted through such magic. Regardless, you seem to have emerged whole and sane. The ⟦E3⟧ appreciates your service.

rows.quest:9085:obj:0: Go to a summoning circle and kill a ⟦E8⟧ of Doom, then return to Commander Thomas Helleran at ⟦E9⟧ in ⟦E10⟧.
rows.quest:9085:details:0: After you bring down the defenses of the Scourge summoning circles that have appeared in the zones under attack, you will be able to confront the acolytes who protect them.
rows.quest:9085:details:1: In truth, these are not men. They are shadows, some of the Lich King's most frightening creatures. They can be revealed using the necrotic runes they carry, and then destroyed with magic or strength of arms.
rows.quest:9085:completion:0: Excellent work, ⟦12⟧ . With the shadows destroyed, it can only be a matter of time before the Lich King decides to recall his necropolises and leave us in peace.
rows.quest:9153:obj:0: Check your map to find an area under Scourge attack. Go there and ⟦E11⟧ a necropolis by defeating the Scourge around them. Return 10 of their Necrotic Runes to Commander Thomas Helleran at ⟦E9⟧ in the ⟦E10⟧.
rows.quest:9153:details:0: The floating necropolises of the Scourge plague the lands of ⟦E12⟧ and ⟦E13⟧ alike. ⟦E14⟧, the ⟦E15⟧, ⟦E16⟧ and the ⟦E17⟧ are blanketed in the shadows of the flying fortresses.
rows.quest:9153:details:1: Only through our combined efforts will they be turned away.
rows.quest:9153:details:2: The necropolises are supported by magical circles at various ⟦E18⟧ in the invaded areas. We have determined that destroying the mindless hordes that surround these circles will destroy their defenses.
rows.quest:9153:progress:0: It will take time to prevail against this ⟦E19⟧. How have you fared, ⟦13⟧?
rows.quest:9153:completion:0: You've done well, ⟦14⟧. Through these incremental defeats, we shall prevail against this renewed Scourge ⟦E19⟧.
rows.quest:9153:completion:1: Rest and recover, but then you must head out to the front again, lest we lose the ground we have gained today.
rows.quest:9153:completion:2: To aid you in your further battles, we will make some of our special items available to you in trade for more necrotic runes.
rows.quest:9247:obj:0: Take the Letter from the Keeper of the Rolls to him at ⟦E9⟧ in the ⟦E10⟧.
rows.quest:9247:details:1: In times past you have served the interests of the ⟦E3⟧, always to the best of your abilities. Now, once again, we sound the clarion call in our time of greatest need.
rows.quest:9247:details:2: B⟦16⟧, please report to the Keeper of the Rolls at ⟦E9⟧ in the ⟦E10⟧ if you are willing to aid us once more.
rows.quest:9247:progress:0: Ah, ⟦17⟧, it is good to see you.
rows.quest:9247:completion:0: Simply by answering the call, we are in your debt, ⟦18⟧. The ⟦E3⟧ is certain that through your shining example, others that are here to aid us will gain great insight into how best to throw back this Scourge Invasion!
rows.quest:9292:obj:0: Bring the ⟦E20⟧ to Lieutenant Orrin outside the gates of ⟦E21⟧.
rows.quest:9292:details:0: On the corpse of the fallen abomination, you discover a cracked crystal, slowly pulsing with necrotic energy.
rows.quest:9292:completion:0: Hm, you took this from the corpse of one of the invading abominations?
rows.quest:9292:completion:1: We have received word about the necropolis base camps that are being summoned by the Scourge. I suspect they wanted to create one inside ⟦E21⟧. It is good that they were unseccessful.
rows.quest:9295:obj:0: Take the Torn Letter to the Keeper of the Rolls at ⟦E9⟧ in the ⟦E10⟧.
rows.quest:9295:details:0: You found this letter on one of the many Scourge minions you've slain. From its appearance and smell, it has been with the ⟦E2⟧ for some time. Perhaps someone at ⟦E9⟧ would be interested in examining it further...
rows.quest:9295:progress:0: Yes? What do you have there?
rows.quest:9295:completion:0: How tragic. These words, clearly meant for someone the soldier loved, never made it to their destination. The events detailed happened years ago; I'm not sure if the intended recipient still lives.
rows.quest:9295:completion:1: There is hope yet, however. With the names and information he gives, I might be able to locate the family! It will take some research, but the librarian in ⟦E21⟧ owes me a favor...
rows.quest:9295:completion:2: Thank you for bringing this to me. With your help, we may be able to grant someone peace of mind at least.

rows.quest:9310:obj:0: Bring the ⟦E22⟧ to Lieutenant Rukag in the courtyard of the ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:9310:details:0: On the corpse of the fallen wight, you find a crystal that is faintly radiating necrotic energy.
rows.quest:9310:progress:0: Can I help you with something?
rows.quest:9310:completion:0: You say this was taken from a wight attacking the city?
rows.quest:9310:completion:1: We have received word about the necropolis base camps that are being summoned by the Scourge. I suspect they were trying to create one in the ⟦E1⟧. We will have to be vigilant in the future.
rows.quest:9154:obj:0: Deliver the ⟦E23⟧ to the Keeper of the Rolls at ⟦E9⟧ in the ⟦E10⟧.
rows.quest:9154:details:0: The Scourge have returned in greater numbers than we have seen before. This must be the doing of the Lich King! The ⟦E3⟧ is recruiting all willing and capable men and women to defend our lands.
rows.quest:9154:details:1: If we share common cause, take this document to the Keeper of the Rolls at ⟦E9⟧ in the ⟦E10⟧.
rows.quest:9154:progress:0: You've come to join our order, have you not?
rows.quest:9154:completion:0: The ⟦E3⟧ placed the call for aid, and you, among others, have answered. There is no time for us to provide you with training. Our faith is placed in your abilities, and that you will join us in throwing back this Scourge ⟦E19⟧.
